item.title: GPT-6 Astra cracked a DEF CON puzzle
item.description: Ben Davis put GPT-6 Astra to the test with puzzles he and his friends spent days working on at DEF CON. Given the same official hint his team received, it solved a Rubik’s cube puzzle three out of three times.
